name: Aurora Under the Trench
introDiscord: An aurora rises from the seabed, flowing upward in ribbons of impossible color. Shizuki's trail indicates she immediately attempted to surf it.
introTwitch: An aurora rises from the seabed, flowing upward in ribbons of impossible color. Shizuki's trail indicates she immediately attempted to surf it.

aurora-under-the-trench-approach.prompt: Three routes weave through rising curtains of light.

left.message:
A Berry rests beside a crude board.

Shizuki wrote: "Aurora surfing attempt #1: spectacular. Landing: less spectacular."

right.message: A star-chart coffer glows beneath the aurora.

forward.message: A Trench Aurora Wisp separates from the curtain and rushes toward you.

aurora-under-the-trench-depths.prompt: The aurora strengthens into luminous currents.

left.message: A Wisp rides the aurora directly into your route.

right.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Aurora surfing attempt #2 recovery supplies."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the recovery supplies untouched. You have wisely not attempted aurora surfing.

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary hangs behind a ribbon of green light.

aurora-under-the-trench-threshold.prompt: Three glowing routes climb toward Curtain of the Deep.

left.message: Star Candies glitter inside a cometglass seam illuminated by the aurora.

right.message: A Wisp drops from the glowing curtain.

forward.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Attempt #3 successful. Glimmer disagrees with definition of successful."
forward.fullHpMessage:
"You leave attempt #3's medical evidence untouched."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The entire aurora folds inward.

A brilliant silhouette forms inside the Curtain of the Deep.

Use /yes to approach or /no to admire the aurora without inventing any new sports.
bossPromptTwitch:
The entire aurora folds inward.

A brilliant silhouette forms inside the Curtain of the Deep.

Use !yes to approach or !no to admire the aurora without inventing any new sports.
bossRetreatText: You retreat beneath the glowing curtain. No surfing occurs.

boss.revealText:
The aurora condenses into a blazing form.

Polar-Flare Wisp reveals itself!

completionText:
"The aurora spreads peacefully across the trench again.

Shizuki's abandoned board remains nearby.

Do not."
